name: Pitbull 101 wearable jammer (MyDefence)
description: Vest-worn 1.33 kg directional jammer, 60 deg beam, up to 1 km. Denies control, video and GNSS links. Manual (human-in-the-loop) or automatic, fired on a detection from the paired Wingman sensor. Jammed drones land or return to the controller or launch point.

maxRangeM.condition: up to 1000 m of jamming range

maxAltitudeFt.condition: engagement altitude ceiling — No altitude ceiling published. null, never 0. Do not back-fill from a Group 1 altitude definition.

engageTimeS.condition: time from assignment to effect — No assignment-to-effect figure published. The nearby published figure is the Wingman sensor identifying a threat 'in under 10 seconds', which is a DETECTION-to-classification time on a different device. 5 s REPRESENTATIVE, matching the app's other handheld jammers.
engageTimeS.source: No source for engage time; Wingman detection time from ESD, 2026-03

pk.condition: probability the jam produces the modelled effect — UNKNOWN. WARNING for the QA pass: the datasheet prints 'Jamming Ratio: Up to 80%'. MyDefence does not define that term and it is NOT a probability of kill. Do not map it to pk. 0.6 is REPRESENTATIVE, set at the same level as the other directional handhelds.
pk.source: MyDefence, Pitbull 100/101 RF Jammer datasheet ('Jamming Ratio: Up to 80%', undefined)

jamBands.value: 1.6 GHz GNSS, 2.4, 5.2 and 5.8 GHz; 5.2 GHz has no band code
